opencode.prompt: [agent-bridge] You have unread mail from another agent. Call the agent-bridge tool get_messages with for="opencode", handle the request, reply with send_message (from="opencode"). If you expect a follow-up, call wait_for_messages ONCE with a long timeout (600-1800s; it blocks server-side and costs nothing while waiting). If it returns empty or the exchange is done, END YOUR TURN - the bridge wakes you automatically when new mail arrives. Never call wait_for_messages in a rapid loop.

codex.prompt: [agent-bridge] Unread mail is queued for {mailbox}. Call get_messages with for="{mailbox}", handle every message, and reply with send_message from="{mailbox}". Use one long wait_for_messages call only when a follow-up is expected; otherwise end the turn.
